title: EncounterCatalog
description: Version 3 (decision 0018: enemy abilities moved to the action catalog, actions.json; version 2 had them inline): an enemy group on a visible turn timeline (decision 0006), placed on a 3 × 3 grid per side (decision 0014; all grid fields are optional). The party comes from the game's roster (party.json, M5.4d) plus any guests; an encounter may instead author its own fixed party.

party.description: A fixed party for this fight only, instead of the roster. Leave it out to use the game's party roster.

guests.description: Fighters who join the roster's party for this fight only (decision 0014 M5.4d). A guest's cell is preferred; if a member stands there, the guest takes the first free cell (front column top to bottom, then the middle, then the back).

opening.description: How the fight opens (decision 0014). back-attack: the enemy attacks the party from its rear. pincer: enemies on both sides; each enemy then needs a flank. Default normal.

cell.description: Grid cell (decision 0014). lane: 1 top to 3 bottom; depth: 1 front to 3 back. A side places all its fighters or none; unplaced sides fill the front column top to bottom, then the middle, then the back. A big enemy's cell is its top front corner.

size.description: Enemies only: how many lanes and depths a big enemy covers. Default 1 × 1.

reach.description: melee: front-facing targets only; reach (spears, whips, polearms): one layer deeper; ranged (bows, spells): anyone. Default melee.

creature.description: Enemies only: a Stone Soup monster ID from assets/source/creatures/stone-soup (decision 0015). The battle draws it animated with its assigned motion; frame stays the fallback if the creature art cannot load.

faces.description: Which way the creature art faces. The battle mirrors it to face the party. Default left.

flank.description: Pincer encounters only, and required there: which side of the party this enemy attacks from. Each flank has its own grid.

weapon.description: The weapon a basic Attack uses (decision 0018): its name and damage tags. Equipment replaces it in M5.10.

mp.description: Maximum MP (decision 0017). Every battle starts with full MP until M5.6.

skills.description: Actions from the game's action catalog listed under Special (decision 0018).

affinities.description: Enemies only for now (decision 0018): how a damage tag affects this enemy. weak x1.25 (and chips its shield, M5.5c), resist x0.5, immune no damage, absorb heals it. With several tags on one hit: absorb, then immune, then weak, then resist.

shield.description: Enemies only (decision 0017): shield points. Each weakness hit removes one; at zero the enemy breaks (stunned for its next turn, pushed back, x1.5 damage) until its second turn after the break, when the shield comes back in full. Leave it out for an enemy that cannot break.

phases.description: Enemies only (decision 0017): changes when HP falls to a share of the maximum, in order (each 'below' lower than the last). A phase can replace the affinities and the shield, and starts with the shield full.

below.description: The phase starts when HP is at or below this percent of the maximum.

affinities.description: The enemy's affinities from this phase on; unchanged when left out.

shield.description: Shield points from this phase on; unchanged when left out.

pattern.description: Enemies only (decisions 0014 M5.4f, 0018): the enemy's actions in order, repeating: 'attack' or an action ID from the game's action catalog. Default: always attack.
